summary: Stone Point Credit Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 29, 2026, reporting that its board declared a quarterly common-stock distribution of $0.430 per share on September 28, 2026, payable September 30 to holders of record September 29. The filing states the distribution equals an annualized yield of roughly 8.8%, based on the quarter-ending September 30, 2026 declared distribution divided by weighted average net asset value. No advisor, premium, stake, buyback, or strategic transaction is disclosed. This is a routine BDC dividend declaration, not a special situation; watch distribution coverage and NAV trends.
